subject.title: Control UI 2026.7.1: poor visibility and discoverability for "More" in the sidebar

question: Should the Control UI preserve the compact More-overflow layout and improve its affordance, or promote more destinations into the default sidebar hierarchy?
rationale: The current behavior is intentional and configurable, while the requested change chooses a default information architecture that affects every Control UI user.

options.title: Strengthen the More affordance
options.body: Keep the current pinned-and-overflow model but make More visually clearer and expose pinning more directly.

options.title: Expand default pinned destinations
options.body: Promote selected destinations into the default navigation, accepting a denser sidebar and a narrower overflow menu.

options.title: Retain the current design
options.body: Close without change if owner feedback or usability evidence shows the current compact navigation remains preferable.

recommendation.title: Strengthen the More affordance
recommendation.body: Keep the current pinned-and-overflow model but make More visually clearer and expose pinning more directly.

likelyOwner.reason: The available release provenance connects this contributor directly to the current sidebar-navigation design.
